Making Worship Rig warm enough to open every day

Ryan: “the design low-key looks a bit cold. It looks just like a vibe coded tool … not something that I would want to come back to on a daily basis.” These are three theme options on the unchanged H-v2 layout. Every screenshot is the real app with the theme injected by Playwright. Nothing under app/ is linked. The full write-up is in OPTIONS.md.

Recommendation: Daylight v2, with its walnut Stage light as the default and paper Day as an opt-in. It is the only finalist that is measurably warmer than today: the room pixels are OKLab b +1.37, against −1.00 today and −3.18 for Sanctuary v2. It also scored highest on the warmth lens (7.5). Its lower total comes from the Build lens only, and those blockers are wiring. The biggest one is that the Electron app never shows #overlay-start, so the start-screen hooks can't appear. That hits every option, Sanctuary included (main.js:39, app/js/main.js:873-878, verified). Before it ships, fix eight things: restore Stage slot chroma, put the chord back in sans at stage size, keep the Today card off Notes under Lock, default to Stage rather than following the Mac, add a reachable light switch, give the Today sheet its own trigger, delete the CSS copy bridge, and add a selector-coverage test.

Today’s shot is the base app with the same song (Sunday Pad + Piano). It was taken while samples were still loading, so it shows the MIDI toasts. test/phase2/ui-core/screenshots/perform.png is the same look with a different song.

1 · Daylight v2: one planner, two lights Recommended

Scores: 6.83

Warmth7.5
Stage7
Build6

Build said “no” because of wiring blockers, not the look.

The idea

  • Stage is walnut (#1b1611 / #261f19, hue 57–67°) with ivory text. Day is warm paper. One light-dark() property switches them.
  • What you read is printed on the desk or on a ruled songbook page (Notes). What you press is a card. There are no dashed boxes.
  • Instrument Sans (61 KB) for controls and Fraunces Soft (55 KB) for the title and the Edit sentence, both OFL. Labels in sentence case.

Daily hook

  • A Today card at the top of Notes. On a weekday: “Practice for Sunday · in 6 days · last played Prayer Wash in D”.
  • A before-service sheet: “Sunday morning · your 3rd Sunday with the rig” (never a streak), where you ended, and “Since then: Building Swell has a longer swell.”
  • Real code: design/warmth/daylight-v2/today.js, 363 lines, store read-only, no schema change.

Stage

  • 0 contrast fails in 11 shots. The lowest is PANIC at 4.67 (Day) and 5.17 (Stage).
  • Glare: mean L 0.080 against 0.073 today. Nothing animates per frame.

Must fix before shipping

  1. Stage slot chroma ≥ 0.15. Pad and Extra are ΔE×100 14, against 26 today.
  2. Chord back in sans 800 at today's size. The idle chord in --faint.
  3. Today card hidden under Lock and after song 2 on a service day, and one line below 1440×800.
  4. Default to Stage, not “follow the Mac”. Lock → Stage only while locked. No crossfade on Lock.
  5. Day · Stage · Auto in Quick › This Mac and in Settings. The Today sheet gets its own trigger (Electron never shows #overlay-start).
  6. Land the strings in JS and delete the ::after copy bridge (screen readers read both).
  7. boot.js in <head> for a flash-free theme, plus font preload and a fitName after fonts load.
  8. Selector-coverage test, the dashed drone key, one “+ Extra / + Bass” well. Day ON lamps must be darker than OFF (1.43:1 vs 3.24:1 now).

Effort M: PR1 theme + switch · PR2 strings · PR3 today.js. Theme: app/themes/daylight-v2/theme.css

2 · Sanctuary v2: the nave at night Highest total

Scores: 7.00

Warmth7
Stage7
Build7

All three critics would use it daily.

The idea

  • Plum-ink neutrals (hue 296–299°), cream text, and brass for “you are here”.
  • Alegreya book serif for song names, Notes and the Edit sentence. Figtree for controls (72 KB, OFL).
  • Lit-glass lamp tiles, a candle-coloured wheel, and a small leaded window that lights while the drone sounds.

Strengths

  • The start screen talks to you like someone who was there last time, and it is day-aware.
  • The serif setlist and Notes feel like his book. The window carries state instead of just decorating.
  • 1292 text nodes with 0 fails. Glare is below today (wheel 0.373 vs 0.469). Deutan separation 0.6 → 8.4.

Why it isn't first

  • It is measurably bluer than today (b −3.18 vs −1.00). The warmth critic reads it as “plum night-mode with gold trim”, close to a premium-dark template.
  • Its body:is(...) wrapper out-specifies the app's state rules. An OFF lamp glows, the OFF badge loses its outline, and the 1024 tracking is lost.
  • Held keys fade into the ivory keybed (1.11:1). Fade out and Faded look alike.
  • The breathing window is an infinite animation whenever the drone is on, and will-change sits on a full-screen layer. Perf is unmeasured.
  • Its hook rides the audio-unlock overlay, which Electron never shows.

Effort S (theme) plus JS for the start screen. Theme: app/themes/sanctuary-v2/theme.css

3 · Studio: the rig as a small analog console Best non-finalist

Scores: 6.67

Warmth7
Stage6
Build7

Stage said no.

The idea

  • A warm-grey desk (hue ~70°), moulded caps that sink when pressed, LED-ladder meters, and brushed fader caps.
  • The song name on label tape. Walnut trim. Rubik only (35 KB, OFL). One 260 ms “filament” flash on off→on, no ambient motion.

Strengths

  • It reads as gear, not a web page. The tape title is personal. An idle LED ladder still looks like a meter.
  • The cleanest theme layer: :where() throughout, and all ~230 targeted classes exist.

Why third

  • The current setlist song loses its amber for beige tape, and the tape appears six times, so “where am I” is harder to find at 1.5 m.
  • Glare is +20–24 % with four slots filled. The tape reads like a lit lamp.
  • “Caps everywhere flatten the hierarchy”: it reads like a plugin screenshot. The desk light and grain never render (a specificity bug).

Effort M. Theme: app/themes/studio/theme.css

How it ships

  • Theme layer: app/themes/<id>/theme.css, every rule inside :where(body[data-theme="<id>"]) (zero specificity), linked last. Fonts go in one shared app/fonts/ with their OFL texts plus LICENSES.md. The total is under 0.2 MB.
  • Settings › Appearance: Look is Warm (default) · Classic. For Daylight, Light is Stage (default) · Day · Auto, mirrored in Quick › This Mac. The look is an optional settings.look field (no schema bump). The light is per Mac in localStorage.
  • Boot: a classic app/themes/boot.js in <head> sets the attributes before first paint.
  • Default: Warm + Stage for everyone. Classic stays for one release as the rollback.
  • Tests: a theme-on ui-core pass, selector coverage, and a contrast audit that includes the ON/OFF lamp pairs, Faded, Lock and chord held.
  • Before it becomes the default: profile on the Mac with the drone on and the meters still, accepting a compositor/GPU difference of 0.5 points or less. Not measured on Apple Silicon yet.
